comparison.objective: Place each girder stop-end in the middle third of its span and clear of the beam.
comparison.physical_skill: Spatial placement and upright positioning of construction components.
comparison.success_condition: Each stop-end is upright, within the specified span region, and clear of the beam; tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: This is geometric placement without tool insertion, unlocking, fine adjustment, locking torque, or response-based commissioning.
